speaker: A5NE8TWS8ZV7B
text: Hey, how's it going?

speaker: A002160837SWJFPIAI7L7
text: Good, how are you?

speaker: A5NE8TWS8ZV7B
text: Good here as well. Do you have a moment to chat about children causes?

speaker: A002160837SWJFPIAI7L7
text: Sure thing. What are they?

speaker: A5NE8TWS8ZV7B
text: I'd like to talk about children who weren't born with the same as opportunities. Particularly children who go hungry everyday and have no place to live. How does that make you feel?

speaker: A002160837SWJFPIAI7L7
text: It sucks that not all people and children have the comfort of having a stable place to stay or the comfort of knowing they are able to eat. It is sad.

speaker: A5NE8TWS8ZV7B
text: What was life like for you growing up? Did you ever have to worry about having enough to eat or having a safe place to live?

speaker: A002160837SWJFPIAI7L7
text: I did not have to worry about those things. Both of my parents were employed and were able to provide for me and my siblings. I felt safe and secure in my home.

speaker: A5NE8TWS8ZV7B
text: That is absolutely wonderful. I feel many people take that for granted. Not having to worry about those things while growing up.

speaker: A002160837SWJFPIAI7L7
text: It is not a problem just for children. There are many homeless adults and adolescents that do not know where their next meal is coming from, or if it will ever arrive.

speaker: A5NE8TWS8ZV7B
text: It would be great if we could work together to assure that everyone have at least those basic necessities met.

speaker: A002160837SWJFPIAI7L7
text: How do you suppose we do that?

speaker: A5NE8TWS8ZV7B
text: We can't help everyone, but we can focus one cause at a time. A cause that you believe in. Have you ever of Save the Children?

speaker: A002160837SWJFPIAI7L7
text: I have not heard of Save the Children? What do they do?

speaker: A5NE8TWS8ZV7B
text: Save the Children is an international non-governmental organization that promotes children's rights, provides relief and helps support children in developing countries.

speaker: A002160837SWJFPIAI7L7
text: That sounds like a good organization. I'm sure they do a lot of nice work.

speaker: A5NE8TWS8ZV7B
text: Would you like to help and donate to them? Your donation will be directly deducted from your task payment. You can choose any amount from $0.50 to all your payment.

speaker: A002160837SWJFPIAI7L7
text: I am not willing to donate from my study payment as this money is vital to me. I am sorry I am unable to help.

speaker: A5NE8TWS8ZV7B
text: That is understandable.

speaker: A002160837SWJFPIAI7L7
text: Thank you for your time and information!
